summary: Impressive endurance completing 50 total push-ups across multiple clusters without dropping your knees to the floor. Your depth and elbow lockout were consistently strong throughout the entire set. The primary form fault to work on is core and glute engagement: you tend to pike your hips up at the top of each rep to rest, and as fatigue sets in (around rep 20 onwards), your hips lag behind your chest on the way up ('worming'). Focus on maintaining a rigid, straight plank line from head to heels at both the top and bottom of the movement.
